title: Fake job offers in practice
intro: A real job never asks you to pay. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Message from Nargiz Market HR | Aynur
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Nargiz Market HR | Aynur
body: Hello! We got your number from your profile on a job site.
Work from home: 1-2 hours a day, 40-120 AZN. Interested?

decisions.explain: An unexpected offer with sky high pay is warning enough.

decisions.title: Interview invitation: operator vacancy
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: Interview invitation: operator vacancy
body: Dear candidate, thank you for your application on the IshBazar site.
Interview: 7 October, 11:00, at our office in Narimanov district.
Please bring your ID card. No payment of any kind is required.

decisions.explain: You applied yourself, the company writes from its own domain and asks for no money.

decisions.title: Message from Nargiz Market HR | Aynur
decisions.prompt: Here is the first task. What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Nargiz Market HR | Aynur
body: First task: give these 3 products 5 stars and send a screenshot.

options.label: No fake reviews, I block them

decisions.explain: Being paid to like and review is a well known sign of this scam.

decisions.title: Message from XezerLog
decisions.prompt: Is this job offer safe or a scam?

artifact.name: XezerLog
body: Your interview is on 7 October at 11:00 at our Narimanov office. Bring your ID card.

decisions.explain: You applied, the interview is in person and no money is asked. This is a normal hiring step.

decisions.title: Message from Remote work | Daily pay
decisions.prompt: Is this job offer safe or a scam?

artifact.name: Remote work | Daily pay
body: Like videos, 2 AZN each. Paid every day.

decisions.explain: Being promised money for likes is how the task scam begins.
